sections.label: Supply Bill appropriations approval
sections.summary: The Supply Bill seeks legislative approval for appropriations from the Consolidated Fund and Development Fund for the Financial Year 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025.

sentences.text: The purpose of the Supply Bill before Members, is to give legislative approval for the appropriations from the Consolidated Fund and Development Fund to meet the expenditure for the Financial Year, 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025.
The Heads of Expenditure and the sums that may be incurred in respect of each Head, are shown in the Schedule to the Bill.
These have been approved by the House in the Main and Development Estimates of Expenditure for the Financial Year, 1 April 2024 to 31 March 2025, as contained in Paper Cmd No 27 of 2024.

The Supply Bill, when approved, will empower the Minister to issue warrants, authorising expenditure up to the amount for each Head as shown in the Bill to be paid out from the Consolidated Fund and Development Fund.
